job.job_title: Sr. Gen AI Engineer & Gen AI Architect
job.job_description:
Hi,

We are inviting experienced professionals to participate in our upcoming In-Person Interview Event for AI and Generative AI opportunities.

Open Roles:

GenAI Engineer
GenAI Architect
Agentic AI Architect

Experience Range: 5 to 15 years

Interview Date: Saturday, 22 August 2026

Interview Locations: Pune, Hyderabad & Mumbai

Designation Levels: Senior Associate, Manager AND Senior Manager

Important Information

Registration is mandatory to be considered for this interview event.
The registration link will be shared with interested candidates.
Profiles will be reviewed and shortlisted based on role requirements.
An official interview call letter will be shared only with shortlisted candidates.
Candidates must carry the interview call letter to attend the interview.

If you are interested in exploring these opportunities with Cognizant, please respond to this invitation. The registration details will be shared with you.

Feel free to share this opportunity with suitable professionals in your network.
